oggetti.descrizione: Provides 50% resistance to fire, gas, acid, and electrical damage.
Provides one-time, short-lived resuscitation upon death, given that the Helldiver's body is still intact. / Increases stim effect duration by 2.0s. / Provides 50% resistance to arc damage.
Provides 80% resistance to gas damage and effects.
Provides 25% resistance to chest damage. / Provides 25% resistance to explosive damage. / Prevents all damage from bleeding if chest hemorrhages.
Bearer is more resistant to being knocked prone. / Reduces damage taken from impact and collisions by 30%. / Provides a higher armor rating.
Provides 50% resistance to explosive damage. / Increases initial inventory and holding capacity of throwables by +2.
Provides 50% resistance to explosive damage. / Provides 25% resistance to gas damage and effects. / Sidearm recoil reduced by 30%.
Provides 50% resistance to explosive damage. / Provides a higher armor rating.
50% chance to not die when taking lethal damage. / Prevents all damage from bleeding if chest hemorrhages.
Provides 40% resistance to fire, gas, acid, and electrical damage. / Increases throwing range by 20%.
Provides 95% resistance to arc damage.
Further reduces recoil when crouching or prone by 30%. / Increases initial inventory and holding capacity of throwables by +2.
Provides a higher armor rating.
Wearer makes 50% less noise when moving. / Increases point-of-interest identification range by 30%. / Provides immunity to leg injuries.
Further reduces recoil when crouching or prone by 30%. / Provides 50% resistance to explosive damage.
Increases sidearms reload speed by 40%. / Sidearm draw/holster speed increased by 50%. / Sidearm recoil reduced by 70%.
Provides 75% damage resistance to fire, allowing bearer to rest assured in their inflammability.
Armor explodes 1.5s after the wearer dies. / Increases initial inventory and holding capacity of throwables by +2.

Provides 50% damage resistance to fire, allowing bearer to rest assured in their inflammability. / Gives the wearer a 50% chance to avoid grievous limb injury. / Reduces damage taken from impact and collisions by 30%.
Increases initial inventory and holding capacity of stims by +2. / Increases stim effect duration by 2.0s.
Increases the wearer's walking speed and running speed. / Increases the speed and duration of slides.
Increases melee damage by 40%. / Improves weapons handling with less drag on weapon movement.
Wearer makes 50% less noise when moving. / Reduces range at which enemies can detect the wearer by 40%.
Increases reload speed of primary weapons by 30%. / Gives wearer a 50% chance to avoid grievous limb injury. / Increases melee damage by 20%.
Increases melee damage by 40%. / Bearer is more resistant to being knocked prone.
Markers placed on the map will generate radar scans every 2.0s. / Reduces range at which enemies can detect the wearer by 30%.
Increases throwing range by 30%. / Provides +50% limb health.
Increases reload speed of primary weapons by 30%. / Increases ammo capacity of all weapons by 20%. Does not affect weapon backpacks.

Reduces weapon sway while aiming by . / Wearer makes less noise when moving. / Mimics foliage-level concealment, reducing enemy detection range while the wearer remains stationary and crouched or prone.
When the wearer takes damage, they regain some stamina. / Provides a higher armor rating.
Increases reload speed of support weapons by 30%. / Slightly increases weapon ergonomics to reduce drag on weapon movement.
Helps prevent Helldivers from flinching when hit. / Provides a higher armor rating. / Markers placed on the map will generate radar scans every 2.0s.
An incendiary grenade which ignites any targets and terrain within the blast radius. use with caution.
This humane device attaches to its target and dispenses repeated electrical pulses, keeping the target in place for humane apprehension and/or termination.
When thrown, the G-11 Caltrops scatters a wide field of proximity-detonated submunitions that slow and stun foes, making them easier to get in your sights.
A high explosive grenade which damages lightly armored targets. Creates high damage over a small area when detonated.
A thermite grenade designed to adhere to surfaces before burning at 2000°C. Capable of burning through some armor.
Detonates on impact, covering the immediate vicinity in self-igniting white phosphorus.
A repurposed firework that showers its immediate surrounding area in sparks before exploding. As delightful as it is incendiary.
A high explosive grenade which detonates on first impact.
Temporarily stuns all targets within the effective radius.
A 'compliance weapon' to modify enemy behavior. Creates a thick smoke screen to block targets' line of sight.
A throwable device engineered to bounce when hitting the ground, releasing bursts of electricity on each impact. Warning: may bounce unpredictably.
A grenade that releases a cloud of toxic gas, effective at blinding and slowing both organic and inorganic enemies.
Designed to render even the largest foes into considerably smaller, and vastly more compliant, constituent parts. Sacrifices throwing range for a massive detonation on impact.
This grenade delivery drone follows the user until it detects an enemy nearby, then flies towards it and explodes on impact. Has a limited battery life.
An antipersonnel fragmentation grenade. Creates damage over a large area when detonated.
Equipped with a heavy payload suitable against armored vehicles, this grenade delivery drone follows the user until it detects an enemy nearby, then flies towards it and explodes on impact.
A cluster fragmentation grenade. The shrapnel submunition allows it to inflict damage over a large area.
An incendiary device that shatters on impact, without explosive force, instantly creating a localized and persistent combustion field.
A smoke grenade that rapidly deploys a small, dense cloud. Allows for rapid personal concealment and exfiltration.
A powerful, single-use, proximity-detonated heat energy mine. During the Fall of Chara, it is said that enough Melta Mines were detonated to outshine the planet's sun.
A throwable emplacement that generates a spherical, projectile-blocking shield on impact. Has a limited lifetime once deployed.
Delivers silent justice to Freedom's enemies.
Creates a far-reaching incendiary blast ideal for crowd control against smaller enemies of Freedom. Equipped with a programmable timer for strategic versatility.
A throwable anti-personnel mine, capable of adhering to most surfaces. Upon deployment, emits lights and sounds which attract nearby hostiles to its proximity-activated detonator.
Mounts a modified AR-23 Liberator to all resupply pods, allowing them to double as automatic turrets.
Equips Hellpods to deploy smokescreens on impact, obscuring Helldiver deployment.
Allows Helldivers to keep sprinting even when they are out of stamina, draining their health instead.
In addition to restoring health, stims temporarily increase movement speed and damage reduction.
Lowers the time it takes for the extraction shuttle to reach the extraction beacon.
Lines all Hellpods with volatile incendiaries that detonate upon impact, igniting any units in vicinity of the drop site.
Reduce time until new reinforcements are granted once they've been depleted.
Helldivers come out of the Hellpod fully stocked on Ammo, Grenades, and Stims.
Increases the number of available reinforcements.

Equips Helldiver uniforms with form-fitting, automated, rapid-response fire suppression systems. Significantly reduces the time it takes to naturally extinguish flames without conducting ground-aided smothering manuevers.
Increases the time between enemy encounters.
Allows all Helldivers to recover faster after being slowed by an attack, such as acid. Does not mitigate “area effects,” such as EMS strikes.
Allows Helldivers to traverse difficult terrain with ease.
Large enemies now have a chance of dropping Samples on death. Capped at 10 drops per mission.
The Sample scanner gives you a 15% chance to receive twice the Samples on sample pick up.
Increases all Helldivers' stamina capacity and recovery.
Exposes Hellpod wiring upon surface contact, stunning any units in the vicinity of the drop site.

Grants two free uses of the Expendable Anti-Tank (EAT) Stratagem per mission; enough to grant a full squad one single-use rocket launcher each, provided squad members employ the proper equipment distribution protocol.
Increases all Helldivers' effective radar range.
Provides minor damage reduction from all sources for all Helldivers.

An assault rifle sporting caseless ammunition and a top-mounted magazine. An electrical firing mechanism releases the rounds in rapid succession upon firing. Equipped with an underslung shotgun for added versatility.
A reliable assault rifle with an antique iron sight, firing incendiary ammunition.
The SEAF standard assault rifle, balancing power, fire rate, and weight for a reliable weapon against smaller targets.
A compact version of the Liberator designed for increased viability in close quarters. Has an increased fire rate at the cost of higher spread.
A modified Liberator featuring concussive rounds which do less damage but stagger enemies.
A modified Liberator fitted with a scope and firing armor-piercing rounds, to help users take down armored targets.
A large-capacity assault rifle firing humane stun rounds. Reports of lethal incidents have been thoroughly debunked.
A fully automatic assault rifle featuring a non-removable suppressor and subsonic ammunition. Slower rounds allow low-profile operation.
A high-caliber assault rifle with a restrictive magazine size but more stopping power.
A combination assault rifle/grenade launcher. Versatile, but heavy to wield.
This shotgun blasts a wide burst of high-voltage electricity that arcs between all units—enemy or otherwise—within range.
An accurate, armor-penetrating rifle, the BR-14 Adjudicator delivers righteous judgement to medium-sized enemies, though its restrictive magazine limits its effectiveness against large groups.
Fires powerful exploding bolts which do maximum damage upon direct impact. Gravity must be accounted for when aiming.
With its two barrels, one trigger, and vintage feel, this shotgun is perfect for historical reenactments.
A lightweight flamethrower. Shoots pressurized fuel through a dispersion nozzle into an open flame

This pump-action grenade launcher trades precision for devastating area-of-effect capabilities with a powerful pump-action grenade launcher. Its manual single-round reload makes it a highly methodical choice for squads requiring an explosive approach to dispute resolution.
Firing jet-propelled rounds, the Dominator trades fire rate and magazine capacity for increased damage per projectile.

A rapid-fire laser submachine gun prioritizing area saturation over pinpoint precision. Its high fire rate makes it effective for close-quarter crowd pacification, provided the user is comfortable with indiscriminate choice of targets.
This time-honored shotgun-like weapon has been improved since the First Galactic War, and now fires six beams instead of three.
A laser rifle, firing in short bursts. Does not need reloading, but if it overheats a new heat sink must be fitted.
A LAS-16 Sickle model with all overheating protections conveniently removed, allowing for far longer bursts of fire. Does more damage when overheating, at the cost of slightly burning the user.
A laser rifle firing a continuous beam. Does not need reloading, but if it overheats a new heat sink must be fitted.
An SMG that fires caseless ammunition and is equipped with a non-removable suppressor. Produced by Martian Armory.
A top-loaded shotgun prominently featured in the final episode of "Obedient Democracy Support Troopers" / Produced by Martian Armory
Often showcased in the "Obedient Democracy Support Troopers" cartoon, this assault rifle comes with a convenient ammo counter and compass. Produced by Martian Armory.
A submachine gun with an extremely high rate of fire, which can be operated with one hand. Ideal for multitasking.
A plasma rifle, firing a bolt of superheated gas which explodes on impact. Avoid standing in proximity to the blast.
A plasma rifle firing a bolt of superheated gas, which can be charged by holding down the trigger. Charging up a shot fully makes the bolt explode on impact.

scheda.danno: 100 Uncharged Bolt + 75 Uncharged + 200 Charged Bolt + 300 Charged

oggetti.descrizione: A high-precision burst-fire plasma rifle that must be charged to fire.
A semi-automatic ceremonial rifle equipped with a bayonet. Can be set to fire in three shot bursts, to easily conduct the Fallen Hero's Salute.
This ceremonial rifle is modeled after antique relics from pre-Democratic times. It is traditionally gifted to every citizen upon turning 16 to encourage service.
This bolt-action rifle fires jet-assisted shells that explode shrapnel in all directions upon impact. Not recommended for close-quarters use.
A heavy, large-caliber marksman rifle bridging the gap between precision and sheer stopping power. Fires armor-piercing rounds coated in a high-ignition thermite compound to ignite targets.
A heavy bolt-action sniper rifle. Fires high-damage armor piercing rounds with exceptional long-range precision, ensuring Democracy can be delivered no matter the distance.
A mighty rifle with a signature lever-action enabling single round reload. Powerful precision suited to mid- and long-range combat.
This high-caliber marksman rifle trades magazine capacity and rate of fire for powerful, accurate shots.
A modified Diligence rifle offering increased damage at the cost of some maneuverability. Fires a single bullet at a time.
oggetti.immagine: R-63CS Diligence Counter Sniper Primary Render.png

oggetti.descrizione: A mid-range precision rifle. Equipped with an integrated suppressor and subsonic rounds for barely-detectable operation.
The alloy in these long-range rifles includes metals from the dead planet Chara, overrun in the First Galactic War. / Produced by ST Construction.
A humane compliance weapon with two separate magazines: one for armor-penetrating flechette rounds and one for stun rounds.
A fully-automatic shotgun with a high rate of fire, excellent for controlling crowds. Requires frequent reloading.
A modified breaker shotgun firing incendiary projectiles. Generates heat during use, so limited to burst fire.
A modified breaker shotgun firing birdshot, small pellets which saturate and area to clear up smaller targets.
A pump shotgun that fires a burst of incendiary phosphorus pellets, setting targets ablaze.
A powerful dual magazine pump-action shotgun, with limited armor penetration. Ideal for small and fast targets.
A modified Punisher shotgun firing exploding plasma rounds. Fire carefully - exploding plasma can injure squadmates.
A Modified Punisher shotgun firing heavy, high-damage slugs. Perfect for punching holes in big targets.
A slamfire shotgun: fires continuously while the trigger is depressed, via activation of the pump-action mechanism. Loaded with armor-piercing flechettes and equipped with an extended bayonet.
A submachine gun with a longer barrel, allowing for higher muzzle velocity and increased armor penetration.
A heavy-duty submachine gun that fires large-caliber rounds, with a slower rate of fire to manage the high recoil. Ideal for use at close to medium range.
A high-caliber submachine gun which can be fired with one hand. Has a relatively low rate of fire.
Fires concussive rounds that stagger enemies. Slower rate of fire than other SMGs.
This versatile submachine gun equipped with iron sights and frontline inciniration capabilities.
A submachine gun with a helical feed magazine, which gives the weapon a higher ammo capacity whilst making it more front-heavy. Produced by Stål Arms.
An assault rifle with a high-capacity drum magazine, good for providing sustained fire. Produced by Stål Arms.
A speed-loaded volley gun with three different firing modes and three different RPM options. Warning: recoil varies significantly between firing modes.
A melee weapon tipped with electrified prongs that temporarily stun targets. Can be wielded one-handed.
A one-handed ceremonial sword suitable for use in parades, sabrage, and combat.
A lightweight melee weapon that temporarily stuns enemies. Can be wielded one-handed.
A heavy one-handed blade. Slower to swing than other melee weapons, but deals more damage.
A heavy-hitting, one-handed melee weapon.
A pistol front-loaded with a single, powerful explosive. The weight of the projectile limits the weapon's range.
A pistol that fires grenades. Must be reloaded between shots.
An accurate, hard-hitting laser revolver with bespoke break action for heat sink swaps.
A laser pistol that fires a continuous beam. Does not require ammo but can overheat and need to change batteries.
A pistol with a built-in laser sight, suppressor, and flashlight. Produced by Martian Armory.
Fires a ballistic dart at near-supersonic speeds, allowing the user to stim allies from a distance. Might sting.
The gas-operated, semiautomatic P-113 chambers the 14mm "Rapid Deliberation," the largest centerfire cartridge of any magazine-fed pistol.
A fully-automatic pistol with an extremely high fire rate, allowing for efficient crowd control.
The SEAF standard pistol - offering a high rate of fire, generous capacity, and fast reloading.
A pistol firing guided, jet-propelled ammunition. It's lock-on feature ensures high accuracy, but the weapon must be reloaded after every round fired.
A missile pistol equipped with sticky projectiles that use phosphorus fuel to burn through an enemy's armor—or any other outer layer—before finally exploding.
A dart-firing pistol. Each of its six rounds administers a gaseous chemical agent, harmful to hostiles whether organic or artificial, that also induces a state of delirium in the target.
A high-damage revolver, which can be reloaded with single rounds. A heavy-hitting and reliable sidearm.
A one-handed machine pistol designed for a compact carry. If the enemy closes in on you, carve a path out with the help of the P-44!
Loaded with jet-assisted rounds, this pistol is calibrated for creating and maintaining tactical distance from encroaching hostiles
A compact handgun-style flamethrower, able to project a jet of fire over short distances.
A pistol firing bursts of guided, jet-propelled ammunition. Can be set to non-guided mode at any time, removing the need to lock on to targets.
The utilitarian sidearm that was standard-issue to the Charan Colonial Guard in the early days of the Galactic Federation. / Produced by ST Construction.
A plasma pistol that charges each shot until the trigger is released. Plasma projectiles explode on impact.
A triple-barreled, break-action, sawed-off shotgun. Switch firing modes to fire all three barrels at once.
Fires a short-ranged superheated blast of thermal energy that melts the heaviest armor and thickest chitin into slag. / Produced by ST Construction.
An automated cannon turret firing anti-tank ammunition over long ranges. Sacrifices agility for range and power.
A turret which fires electrical charges at targets in close range. To avoid friendly fire, remain prone.
An automated flamethrower turret. Warning: fuel canister prone to explosion when ruptured.
An automated turret with an extremely high rate of fire. Caution: does not check if friendly units are in line of fire.

An automated turret that fires gas shells. Its targeting system prioritizes hostiles not yet exhibiting symptoms caused by gas inhalation. Users are advised to stay significantly upwind of the resulting crowd control.
oggetti.immagine: Gas Mortar Sentry Stratagem Icon Background.svg

oggetti.descrizione: A turret firing powerful and precise laser beams. Warning: overloading heat sink may cause adverse effects.
A turret firing powerful shells in a high arc. Effective at long ranges, and able to strike at targets behind cover.
A turret firing static field generators that slow the advance of enemies.
oggetti.immagine: EMS Mortar Sentry Stratagem Icon Background.svg

oggetti.descrizione: An agile automated machine gun turret. Will fire at targets even if Helldivers will be caught in the crossfire.
oggetti.immagine: Machine Gun Sentry Stratagem Icon Background.svg

oggetti.descrizione: A powerfully automated turret, effective against armored targets. The turret will primarily aim at larger enemies.
A fully-automatic cannon effective against light vehicle armor. Includes support backpack required for reloading.
A colossal anti-materiel sniper rifle. While its immense kinetic recoil mandates its user crouch or lie prone, its backpack-fed 20mm rounds deliver final, un-appealable verdicts to armoured threats.
A high-caliber sniper rifle effective over long distances against light vehicle armor. This rifle must be aimed downscope.
Projects an arc of lightning at close range. Charges up to project bolts, and may discharge through multiple targets.
An autonomous drone equipped with a Liberator assault rifle, providing 360° cover. Returns to backpack to rearm.
A humane, autonomous drone equipped with a modified Arc Thrower. Capable of projecting arcs of lightning through multiple targets. Does not need to recharge between shots.
An autonomous drone equipped with a flamethrower. Returns to pack to refill fuel canisters
An autonomous drone equipped with a laser rifle, providing 360° cover. Returns to backpack to cool down.
A drone that defends its user by firing caustic gas at nearby enemies, blinding them and slowing them temporarily. Returns to backpack to refill.
Supply boxes containing ammunition, with a backpack that allows the user to distribute boxes to fellow Helldivers.
A backpack-mounted Hellbomb that can be armed by the wearer or an ally, starting a countdown. Users are recommended to remove the backpack before the countdown reaches zero.
Incendiary support fed by a massive fuel tank. This heavy flamethrower enables a continuous column of fire to cleanse the battlefield.
A backpack containing six adhesive C4 charges and a handheld wireless electronic detonator. Charges can be deployed and detonated individually, or as multiple simultaneous blasts.
oggetti.immagine: B MD C4 Pack Support Render.png

oggetti.descrizione: The eternal colors of Super Earth can never be tainted. Only quenched, by the blood of its enemies.
oggetti.immagine: CQC-1 One True Flag Support Render.png

oggetti.descrizione: A sledgehammer that can be wielded with or without an explosive charge attached to its head.
A useful field-clearing tool for removing trees, obstacles, and unlucky foes.
A powerful manned gun emplacement, capable of taking out armoured targets at long ranges.
A stationary ballistic cover with a mounted grenade launcher. Can protect multiple Helldivers from small arms fire
A manned gun emplacement offering superior firepower against lightly armored targets. Slow to turn, so place it wisely.
A barrage of rocket pods, which the Eagle pilot will release on the largest target near the stratagem beacon.
oggetti.immagine: Eagle 110mm Rocket Pods Stratagem Icon Background.svg

oggetti.descrizione: A large bomb obliterating almost any target close to impact. Make sure to clear the area. Big Booms!
A barrage of bombs creating a non-targeted carpet of explosions. When called the strike will be perpendicular from the direction you were facing when thrown.
A targeted air strike unable to destroy buildings, but efficient at clearing smaller targets.
oggetti.immagine: Eagle Cluster Bomb Stratagem Icon Background.svg
Eagle Gas Airstrike Stratagem Icon Background.svg

oggetti.descrizione: A barrage of napalm bombs, creating a wall of fire which will stop the enemy in their tracks.
oggetti.immagine: Eagle Napalm Airstrike Stratagem Icon Background.svg

oggetti.descrizione: A barrage of smoke grenades, creating a thick smoke screen to block enemies' line of sight.
oggetti.immagine: Eagle Smoke Strike Stratagem Icon Background.svg

oggetti.descrizione: A strafing run of the battlefield to clear small targets, delivered almost instantly. When called the strike will start from the beacon and go away from the direction you were facing when thrown
oggetti.immagine: Eagle Strafing Run Stratagem Icon Background.svg

oggetti.descrizione: A single-use weapon specialized for damaging vehicle armor. Discarded after every use.
A single-use weapon firing a high-yield missile. Discarded after every use.
A single-use weapon that fires a missile containing napalm cluster bombs that release upon impact.
An Exosuit equipped with a rocket launcher and a gatling gun, offering reliable flexibility against both heavy units and swarms of smaller targets.
An Exosuit equipped with dual autocannons, designed for sustained explosive firepower.
A modern reinvention of the Lumberers of the first Galactic War, this Exosuit is equipped with a flamethrower and an anti-tank cannon.
An Exosuit equipped with a flak cannon and ballistic shield, optimized for mid-to-close combat range.
An anti-tank homing missile which must lock onto its target before launch. Effective against large and armored enemies.
oggetti.immagine: FAF-14 Spear Weapon and Backpack Support Render.png

oggetti.descrizione: An incendiary weapon for close range. Will ignite targets, terrain, and any flammable teammates.
A stationary energy shield which provides cover against projectiles. Has a limited lifetime once deployed.
oggetti.immagine: Shield Generator Relay Stratagem Icon Background.svg

oggetti.descrizione: A grenade launcher effective against armored infantry. Not intended for use against vehicle armor or fortified buildings.
A grenade launcher that can be fired continuously to deliver a nonstop barrage of explosives.
A humane grenade launcher firing high-powered arc grenades.
A recoilless rifle effective against vehicle armor. Includes support backpack required for reloading.

A sleek energy rifle requiring a brief charge cycle to fire a high-precision, non-explosive thermal projectile. Features infinite ammunition and an optimised cooldown cycle enabled by venting steam after each discharge.
A laser weapon firing a continuous beam. Doesn't require ammunition, but will need heat sink replaced if it overheats.
Charges up to fire a powerful, explosive energy burst. Has a long cooldown period after firing.

A Dark Fluid-powered backpack that generates a portable micro-wormhole. This safe and well-understood technology allows the wearer to warp short distances. Warning: do not use while pack is overloaded.
Enables the user to jump higher than 'gravity' and 'safety' would normally allow. Must be charged before use.
Offers its user brief fixed-height flight, stable enough for precise marksmanship.
A belt-fed minigun with an exceptional ammo capacity. Cannot be reloaded with standard non-belted munitions.
A lightly-armored Fast Recon Vehicle mounted with a heavy machinegun.
oggetti.immagine: Fast Recon Vehicle Stratagem Icon Background.svg

oggetti.descrizione: A high-speed Fast Recon Vehicle equipped with an automated defense turret and a mounted supply rack, allowing frontline personnel to fully replenish ammunition and medical supplies on the move.

A specialized Fast Recon Vehicle equipped with heavier armor, a spiked ramming grille, and a roof-mounted heavy flamethrower at the expense of seating; this FRV can enable up to three Helldivers to deliver high-speed Justice, and forcefully clear obstructed transport routes.
A compact, low caliber machine gun. Trades power for ease of use, with faster reloading than heavier machine guns.
Scatters powerful anti-tank mines that deal heavy, armor-penetrating damage. Minefield is less densely packed relative to smaller mines.
Deploys a defensive anti-personnel minefield, to halt the enemy advance.
Deploys mines that release gas on activation, temporarily blinding and slowing most enemies.
Deploys a defensive incendiary minefield, which will set both terrain and targets alight when triggered.
A very powerful but difficult-to-wield machine gun with intense recoil.
oggetti.immagine: MG-206 Heavy Machine Gun Support Render.png

oggetti.descrizione: A machine gun designed for stationary use. Trades higher power for increased recoil and reduced accuracy.

A single-use weapon sporting caseless ammunition stacked in multiple barrels. An electrical firing mechanism releases the rounds in rapid succession upon firing, after which the weapon is to be discarded.
An expendable missile launcher equipped with four laser-guided missiles.
A silo that fits one single, powerful missile. Comes with a handheld targeting remote.
A precision artillery salvo over a small area, perfect for taking out concentrated enemy units.
oggetti.immagine: Orbital 120mm HE Barrage Stratagem Icon Background.svg

oggetti.descrizione: A prolonged barrage, wreaking extended destruction over a large area. Communication with teammates is advised.
oggetti.immagine: Orbital 380mm HE Barrage Stratagem Icon Background.svg

oggetti.descrizione: A projectile which explodes while airborne, creating a deadly rain of shrapnel. Not effective against heavy armor.
oggetti.immagine: Orbital Airburst Strike Stratagem Icon Background.svg

oggetti.descrizione: A "compliance weapon" to modify enemy behavior. The projectile stuns all targets within the strike radius.
oggetti.immagine: Orbital EMS Strike Stratagem Icon Background.svg

oggetti.descrizione: A projectile which releases a cloud of corrosive gas, harmful to both organic and robotic lifeforms.
oggetti.immagine: Orbital Gas Strike Stratagem Icon Background.svg

oggetti.descrizione: A barrage of high explosive rounds, fired from the Destroyer's high speed rotary autocannons.
oggetti.immagine: Orbital Gatling Barrage Stratagem Icon Background.svg

oggetti.descrizione: The Destroyer's laser cannon will sweep over the designated area, vaporizing all targets within the effective radius.
Launches a prolonged barrage of napalm shells over a wide area, setting a swath of land ablaze in mere moments.
oggetti.immagine: Orbital Napalm Barrage Stratagem Icon Background.svg

oggetti.descrizione: A single precise shot from the Destroyer's 'ATLAS' cannon.
oggetti.immagine: Orbital Precision Strike Stratagem Icon Background.svg

oggetti.descrizione: A high-velocity railcannon round fired at the largest target in close proximity to the beacon. Targeting is automatic.
oggetti.immagine: Orbital Railcannon Strike Stratagem Icon Background.svg

oggetti.descrizione: Creates a large, thick smoke screen to block targets' line of sight.
oggetti.immagine: Orbital Smoke Strike Stratagem Icon Background.svg

oggetti.descrizione: A linear artillery barrage which moves at intervals, driving the enemy out from cover while allowing an advance.
oggetti.immagine: Orbital Walking Barrage Stratagem Icon Background.svg

oggetti.descrizione: A powerful plasma weapon that fires one blast at a time, each blast exploding on impact. Must be charged to fire. Warning: do not overcharge.

scheda.danno: 400 Uncharged Bolt + 500 Uncharged Explosion + 800 Charged Bolt + 800 Charged Explosion

oggetti.descrizione: Fires a rocket that detonates within proximity of a target, and deploys a cluster of explosive bomblets.
An experimental weapon which prioritizes armor penetration. Must be charged between shots - choose targets carefully.
A speargun firing heavy-duty projectiles. These projectiles release a cloud of gas on impact, and must be carefully loaded one at a time.
A backpack which can be wielded as a one-handed ballistic shield, protecting against small arms fire.
oggetti.immagine: Ballistic Shield Backpack Stratagem Icon Background.svg

oggetti.descrizione: Encloses the wearer in a spherical shield which blocks high-speed projectiles. Has a limited lifetime once deployed.
oggetti.immagine: Shield Generator Pack Stratagem Icon Background.svg

oggetti.descrizione: A one-handed device that deploys a wide energy barrier in front of the user. The barrier is semipermeable and blocks high-speed projectiles from the outside only, leaving the user free to shoot through it."

A versatile missile launcher loaded with seven lock-on homing missiles. These can either be fired from the launcher directly or as an airburst. Includes support backpack required for reloading. Produced by Stål Arms.

A heavily-armoured Infantry Fighting Vehicle (IFV) armed with front-mounted dual Gatling guns, equipped with a deployable smoke screen, and featuring rear-mounted missile silos--its projectiles laser-guided by the gunner's turret.
A heavily-armored tank destroyer armored with a 120mm high-velocity cannon and a heavy coaxial machinegun.
oggetti.immagine: Bastion MK XVI Stratagem Icon Background.svg

oggetti.descrizione: Atomizes caustic chemicals into a fine mist that liquifies sensitive electronics and tissues. Blinds and slows most enemies.
